NOTE the index correction this caught: a first p4 crop taken at y=49.91 rendered empty and looked like a missing row — it was in fact the one-past band, because on this UNDERLINE form the text sits ABOVE its rule, so band N ends at rule N. Nothing was changed by any crop; the widening is ADDENDUM G2 handling, not a re-reading.

3.measure_note: THIS 2020 FILING IS ON THE LEGACY UNDERLINE FORM, NOT the 2020 boxed grid — the launch brief's warning that some 2020 filings are still legacy_colAB is confirmed on the page ('FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES', Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5, four-column per-row underlines). So ADDENDUM I3's boxed-grid rule does NOT apply here and CHUNK_BRIEF 6 / ADDENDUM A1 DOES: THE TEXT SITS ABOVE ITS UNDERLINE, row N spans [rule N-1, rule N], and row 1 has no rule above it — its band is extrapolated one pitch (3.8906) up from the first detected rule at 20.55, giving [16.66, 20.55]. rowbands.py (skew 0.0) returns 17 per-column rules 20.55..82.80 = 17 usable lines (the ADDENDUM H1 count, confirmed here). v_rules_pct is EMPTY on this page (no vertical rules are printed at all), so the four column bands come from the per-rule SEGMENTS as CHUNK_BRIEF 6 prescribes: Date 7.29-18.53, Name of Contributor 20.00-52.53, Mailing Address & Zip Code 54.00-80.88, Amount 82.35-92.12 — assigned by CONTENT and then by the printed headings. TWO-CROP PROOF at 900 dpi: pct:82.35,16.66,14.65,3.89@p3 rendered '100.00' (recorded 100.00, Jon Bartlett) and pct:82.35,20.55,14.65,3.88@p3 rendered '150.00' (recorded 150.00, Bruce Bartlett, the last transcribed row). FIRST-ENTRY CONTROL (A1): the extrapolated band 1 rendered the first written entry itself, so this filer did NOT skip the first ruled line, and no banner or voided line consumes an index. ONE-PAST-THE-END CONTROL (B5/F1): pct:82.35,24.43,9.77,3.93@p3 rendered an EMPTY band between two rules — no figure, so the ledger does not continue below the block and trap 5 does not apply. No band is ~2x pitch, so no rule was missed and no band holds two entries.
3.overflow_note: G2 OVERFLOW IS A WHOLE-FILING PROPERTY HERE: this filer's figures run PAST the amount column's right-hand rule at 92.12 on both schedules, so a crop bounded by the printed band clips the last digit. The frame above is retained as the honest measurement of the printed grid, and EVERY row carries an explicit widened `geometry` string (right edge 97.00) that renders the whole figure.
